grammar.pattern: V + 得 / 不 + 结果；V + 得 / 不 + 了
grammar.purpose: Describe potential completion rather than permission
grammar.explanation: 看得懂/看不懂 describes whether understanding is possible. 拿得动/拿不动 describes ability to move an item. 今天处理得了这些邮件吗 asks whether completion is manageable; 了 is liǎo in this potential complement. 不可以 is a permission judgment, different from 看不懂. A capability statement does not establish actual completion.

examples.py: zhè fēng yóu jiàn wǒ kàn de dǒng .

examples.zh: 这些邮件今天处理不了。
examples.py: zhè xiē yóu jiàn jīn tiān chǔ lǐ bù le .
examples.en: These emails cannot be dealt with today.

examples.py: tā ná bù dòng zhè gè xiāng zi .
examples.en: She cannot lift or move this box.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看得懂就是已经看完了。
commonMistakes.right: 看得懂表示能够理解，不代表已经看完。
commonMistakes.why: Potential completion and actual completion differ.

grammar.pattern: V + 次数 + 名物 / V + 代词 + 次数
grammar.purpose: Place the object with an event count
grammar.explanation: 我看了两遍报告 puts the noun object after the count. 我问了她三次 puts a pronoun object before the count. With people’s names, different placements are possible according to context; do not invent an absolute placement rule for all nouns. Keep the counted event distinct from the number of objects: 看两遍报告 is two readings, not necessarily two reports.

examples.py: wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn bào gào .
wǒ gěi tā dǎ le liǎng cì diàn huà .
wǒ wèn le tā sān cì .

commonMistakes.why: For this ordinary pronoun-object count, put 她 before 三次.

lines.zh: 旅行社发来的电子邮件，你看了吗？
lines.py: lǚ xíng shè fā lái de diàn zi yóu jiàn , nǐ kàn le ma ?
lines.en: Have you read the travel agency's email?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 看了两遍，日期看懂了，最后那张表还没填。
lines.py: kàn le liǎng biàn , rì qī kàn dǒng le , zuì hòu nà zhāng biǎo hái méi tián .
lines.en: Twice. I understand the dates, but I haven't filled in the form at the end.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你不是昨天就发出去了吗？
lines.py: nǐ bù shì zuó tiān jiù fā chū qù le ma ?
lines.en: Didn't you send it yesterday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我发的是问题，不是填好的表。我想问能不能周五出发。
lines.py: wǒ fā de shì wèn tí , bù shì tián hǎo de biǎo . wǒ xiǎng wèn néng bù néng zhōu wǔ chū fā .
lines.en: I sent a question, not a completed form. I asked whether we could leave on Friday.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 他们怎么说？
lines.py: tā men zěn me shuō ?
lines.en: What did they say?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没回。我早上又问了一次，怕邮件进了别的邮箱。
lines.py: hái méi huí . wǒ zǎo shàng yòu wèn le yī cì , pà yóu jiàn jìn le bié de yóu xiāng .
lines.en: No reply yet. I asked again this morning in case the email went to another inbox.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 要不下午打电话？网上的日期不一定还有地方。
lines.py: yào bù xià wǔ dǎ diàn huà ? wǎng shàng de rì qī bù yí dìng hái yǒu dì fāng .
lines.en: Shall we call this afternoon? There might not still be places for the dates online.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，你三点有空吗？我有些话不知道怎么问。
lines.py: hǎo , nǐ sān diǎn yǒu kōng ma ? wǒ yǒu xiē huà bù zhī dào zěn me wèn .
lines.en: Sure. Are you free at three? I'm unsure how to ask a few things.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 有。我坐你旁边，你先说，问不清楚我再帮你。
lines.py: yǒu . wǒ zuò nǐ páng biān , nǐ xiān shuō , wèn bù qīng chǔ wǒ zài bāng nǐ .
lines.en: Yes. I'll sit beside you. You start; if anything's unclear, I'll help.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我先把要问的写下来，别到时候又忘了。
lines.py: nà wǒ xiān bǎ yào wèn de xiě xià lái , bié dào shí hou yòu wàng le .
lines.en: I'll write my questions down first so I don't forget them again.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Whether Friday departure is available
Whether a newspaper has been printed
Whether the learner owns the agency

reading.title: Two readings, one report
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我想和朋友周五出发，周日晚上回来。旅行社的网页上写着周四出发，我们就发邮件问有没有别的安排。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng hé péng you zhōu wǔ chū fā , zhōu rì wǎn shang huí lái . lǚ xíng shè de wǎng yè shàng xiě zhe zhōu sì chū fā , wǒ men jiù fā yóu jiàn wèn yǒu méi yǒu bié de ān pái .
lines.en: My friend and I wanted to leave Friday and return Sunday evening. The agency's website said Thursday, so we emailed about other options.

lines.zh: 第二天还没收到回复，朋友问我是不是已经订好了。我把发出去的邮件给她看，最后一句明明是问句。
lines.py: dì èr tiān hái méi shōu dào huí fù , péng you wèn wǒ shì bú shì yǐ jīng dìng hǎo le . wǒ bǎ fā chū qù de yóu jiàn gěi tā kàn , zuì hòu yī jù míng míng shì wèn jù .
lines.en: The next day there was still no reply. My friend asked whether I'd booked. I showed her the email: its final sentence was clearly a question.

lines.zh: 下午三点，我们一起打电话。工作人员说周五也有位置，不过回来要到周一。
lines.py: xià wǔ sān diǎn , wǒ men yì qǐ dǎ diàn huà . gōng zuò rén yuán shuō zhōu wǔ yě yǒu wèi zhì , bù guò huí lái yào dào zhōu yī .
lines.en: At three we called together. The staff member said there were Friday places, but the return would be Monday.

lines.zh: 我周一有课，不能参加这次旅行。朋友说没关系，我们可以找近一点的地方，不一定跟团。
lines.py: wǒ zhōu yī yǒu kè , bù néng cān jiā zhè cì lǚ xíng . péng you shuō méi guān xì , wǒ men kě yǐ zhǎo jìn yī diǎn de dì fāng , bù yí dìng gēn tuán .
lines.en: I had class Monday, so couldn't take that trip. My friend said we could find somewhere nearer and needn't join a group.

lines.zh: 电话结束以后，我写下了新的安排。我们周六去附近的城市，晚上就回来，不用请假。
lines.py: diàn huà jié shù yǐ hòu , wǒ xiě xià le xīn de ān pái . wǒ men zhōu liù qù fù jìn de chéng shì , wǎn shang jiù huí lái , bù yòng qǐng jià .
lines.en: After the call I wrote down our new plan: visit a nearby city Saturday and return that evening, without taking time off.

lines.zh: 那张没填的表留在邮箱里。朋友说下次再看它吧，这次先找一家好吃的店。
lines.py: nà zhāng méi tián de biǎo liú zài yóu xiāng lǐ . péng you shuō xià cì zài kàn tā ba , zhè cì xiān zhǎo yī jiā hǎo chī de diàn .
lines.en: The unfinished form stayed in my inbox. My friend said we'd look at it another time; for now, we should find a good restaurant.

choices: A nearby city on Saturday and home that evening
The agency trip returning Monday
No further outings ever
questions.answer: A nearby city on Saturday and home that evening

questions.q: Why does the agency’s Friday option fail?
choices: Its Monday return conflicts with class
Friday places are sold out
The friend cannot read emails
questions.answer: Its Monday return conflicts with class

choices: Its final question shows there was no booking
It proves Monday class was cancelled
Its length proves the agency agreed

lines.py: nǐ gěi lǚ xíng shè xiě le duō zhǎng de yóu jiàn ?

lines.py: bù zhǎng , jiù jǐ gè wèn tí .
lines.en: Not long. Just a few questions.

lines.zh: 我看着怎么有两页？
lines.py: wǒ kàn zhe zěn me yǒu liǎng yè ?
lines.en: Why does it look like two pages?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 一页是问题，一页是我怕他们没看见，又写了一遍。
lines.py: yī yè shì wèn tí , yī yè shì wǒ pà tā men méi kàn jiàn , yòu xiě le yī biàn .
lines.en: One page is the questions. I repeated them on another in case they missed them.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 难怪你看了两遍。
lines.py: nán guài nǐ kàn le liǎng biàn .
lines.en: No wonder you read it twice.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好了，我以后少写一点。你先帮我看最后一句。
lines.py: hǎo le , wǒ yǐ hòu shǎo xiě yī diǎn . nǐ xiān bāng wǒ kàn zuì hòu yī jù .
lines.en: All right, I'll keep it shorter next time. Help me check the last sentence first.

lines.en: I saw a report about this event online.

lines.zh: 这篇报道介绍了当地的变化。
lines.py: zhè piān bào dào jiè shào le dāng dì de biàn huà .
lines.en: This report describes changes in the local area.

lines.zh: 她的报告一共写了五页。
lines.py: tā de bào gào yī gòng xiě le wǔ yè .
lines.en: Her report is five pages long.

lines.zh: 老师让我们下周交报告。
lines.py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men xià zhōu jiāo bào gào .
lines.en: The teacher asked us to hand in our reports next week.

lines.zh: 我已经发出邀请了。
lines.py: wǒ yǐ jīng fā chū yāo qǐng le .
lines.en: I've sent out the invitation.

lines.zh: 通知发出以后，几个人马上回复了。
lines.py: tōng zhī fā chū yǐ hòu , jǐ gè rén mǎ shàng huí fù le .
lines.en: Several people replied immediately after the notice went out.

lines.zh: 他在学校的报上发表了一篇文章。
lines.py: tā zài xué xiào de bào shàng fā biǎo le yī piān wén zhāng .
lines.en: He published an article in the school newspaper.

lines.zh: 她刚发表了一篇短故事。
lines.py: tā gāng fā biǎo le yī piān duǎn gù shì .
lines.en: She's just published a short story.

lines.zh: 她用电子邮件联系了老师。
lines.py: tā yòng diàn zi yóu jiàn lián xì le lǎo shī .
lines.en: She contacted the teacher by email.

lines.zh: 我们还没收到他的电子邮件。
lines.py: wǒ men hái méi shōu dào tā de diàn zi yóu jiàn .
lines.en: We haven't received his email yet.

lines.zh: 我还有三封邮件没看。
lines.py: wǒ hái yǒu sān fēng yóu jiàn méi kàn .
lines.en: I have three unread emails.

lines.zh: 这封邮件是昨天晚上来的。
lines.py: zhè fēng yóu jiàn shì zuó tiān wǎn shang lái de .
lines.en: This email arrived last night.

lines.zh: 请把新的邮箱地址发给我。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ xīn de yóu xiāng dì zhǐ fā gěi wǒ .
lines.en: Please send me your new email address.

lines.zh: 你看看邮箱里有没有新的通知。
lines.py: nǐ kàn kàn yóu xiāng lǐ yǒu méi yǒu xīn de tōng zhī .
lines.en: Check your inbox for a new notice.

lines.zh: 我在信封上贴了一张邮票。
lines.py: wǒ zài xìn fēng shàng tiē le yī zhāng yóu piào .
lines.en: I put a stamp on the envelope.

lines.zh: 她从小就喜欢收集邮票。
lines.py: tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huān shōu jí yóu piào .
lines.en: She's liked collecting stamps since childhood.

lines.zh: 这个信封太小，放不下照片。
lines.py: zhè gè xìn fēng tài xiǎo , fàng bù xià zhào piān .
lines.en: This envelope is too small for the photo.

lines.zh: 请把地址写在信封上。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ dì zhǐ xiě zài xìn fēng shàng .
lines.en: Please write the address on the envelope.

lines.zh: 出发以前，先把证件收好。
lines.py: chū fā yǐ qián , xiān bǎ zhèng jiàn shōu hǎo .
lines.en: Put your identification documents away safely before leaving.

lines.zh: 这些证件都是我自己的。
lines.py: zhè xiē zhèng jiàn dōu shì wǒ zì jǐ de .
lines.en: These identification documents are all mine.

lines.zh: 我的身份证放在钱包里。
lines.py: wǒ de shēn fèn zhèng fàng zài qián bāo lǐ .
lines.en: My identity card is in my wallet.

lines.zh: 我找了半天，才找到身份证。
lines.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān , cái zhǎo dào shēn fèn zhèng .
lines.en: I spent ages looking before finding my identity card.

lines.zh: 我们毕业以后还一直通信。
lines.py: wǒ men bì yè yǐ hòu hái yì zhí tōng xìn .
lines.en: We've kept corresponding since graduation.

lines.zh: 我们以前用信通信，现在主要发邮件。
lines.py: wǒ men yǐ qián yòng xìn tōng xìn , xiàn zài zhǔ yào fā yóu jiàn .
lines.en: We used to correspond by letter; now we mostly email.

lines.zh: 这次交易已经完成了。
lines.py: zhè cì jiāo yì yǐ jīng wán chéng le .
lines.en: This transaction is complete.

lines.zh: 这次交易的时间还没有确定。
lines.py: zhè cì jiāo yì de shí jiān hái méi yǒu què dìng .
lines.en: The time of this transaction hasn't been fixed yet.

lines.zh: 通过海关以后，我们去拿行李。
lines.py: tōng guò hǎi guān yǐ hòu , wǒ men qù ná xíng lǐ .
lines.en: After going through customs, we collected our luggage.

lines.zh: 她在海关工作了很多年。
lines.py: tā zài hǎi guān gōng zuò le hěn duō nián .
lines.en: She's worked at customs for many years.

lines.zh: 我想问旅行社能不能改时间。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn lǚ xíng shè néng bù néng gǎi shí jiān .
lines.en: I'd like to ask the travel agency whether the time can be changed.

lines.zh: 这家旅行社离学校很近。
lines.py: zhè jiā lǚ xíng shè lí xué xiào hěn jìn .
lines.en: This travel agency is near the school.

lines.zh: 我信你的话，你不用再解释了。
lines.py: wǒ xìn nǐ de huà , nǐ bù yòng zài jiě shì le .
lines.en: I believe you; you don't need to explain again.

lines.zh: 这件事听着奇怪，我有点不信。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì tīng zhe qí guài , wǒ yǒu diǎn bù xìn .
lines.en: This sounds strange; I don't quite believe it.

lines.zh: 大使馆的地址写在这张纸上。
lines.py: dà shǐ guǎn de dì zhǐ xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng .
lines.en: The embassy's address is on this piece of paper.

lines.zh: 我们约好在大使馆附近见面。
lines.py: wǒ men yuē hǎo zài dà shǐ guǎn fù jìn jiàn miàn .
lines.en: We've arranged to meet near the embassy.

lines.zh: 这本书要十美元。
lines.py: zhè běn shū yào shí měi yuán .
lines.en: This book costs ten US dollars.

lines.zh: 他还有二十美元没花。
lines.py: tā hái yǒu èr shí měi yuán méi huā .
lines.en: He still has twenty US dollars left.

lines.zh: 他们还在准备开店需要的资金。
lines.py: tā men hái zài zhǔn bèi kāi diàn xū yào de zī jīn .
lines.en: They're still raising the funds needed to open the shop.

lines.zh: 资金准备好了，他们就开始找地方。
lines.py: zī jīn zhǔn bèi hǎo le , tā men jiù kāi shǐ zhǎo dì fāng .
lines.en: Once the funds were ready, they started looking for a space.

lines.zh: 我们还没有收到正式通知。
lines.py: wǒ men hái méi yǒu shōu dào zhèng shì tōng zhī .
lines.en: We haven't received an official notice yet.

lines.zh: 我们下周正式开始上课。
lines.py: wǒ men xià zhōu zhèng shì kāi shǐ shàng kè .
lines.en: Classes officially begin next week.

lines.zh: 他的学生证掉在教室里了。
lines.py: tā de xué sheng zhèng diào zài jiào shì lǐ le .
lines.en: He dropped his student card in the classroom.

lines.zh: 这张工作证是上个月办的。
lines.py: zhè zhāng gōng zuò zhèng shì shàng gè yuè bàn de .
lines.en: This staff identification card was issued last month.

prompt.zh: 你只是问有没有安排，还没有付款，订好了吗？

prompt.en: You only asked about arrangements and have not paid. Is it booked?

choices: 没有，我还在等他们回复。
已经付款订好了。
我已经收到正式确认了。
tasks.answer: 没有，我还在等他们回复。
tasks.why: This response follows the stated problem without contradicting the passage.

prompt.zh: 周一有课，不能参加周一才回来的旅行，怎么改？
prompt.py: zhōu yī yǒu kè , bù néng cān jiā zhōu yī cái huí lái de lǚ xíng , zěn me gǎi ?

choices: 换个周日以前能回来的安排。
继续订周一回来的那趟。
不改时间，还是周一回来。
tasks.answer: 换个周日以前能回来的安排。
tasks.why: This response follows the stated problem without contradicting the passage.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三48, 三50. Native check: newspaper 报 versus report 报告/报道, verb 信, potential 了 liǎo, noun/pronoun placement with event counts, working-ID 证 reference and original verse rhythm. Embassy and customs content is fictional language practice, never current procedural or financial advice. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三35 / 三36 / 三43 / 三44: 她看起来很累，先问本人。, 照片看上去很亮，不说明现场温度。, 学习汉语需要时间。, 我希望大家都看懂说明。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Removed grammar-analysis and permission disclaimers from character speech. The scene has one practical problem and a coherent timeline; unrelated vocabulary now has independent examples. Dates, times, causal questions and distractors were checked against their own passage. Every Chinese line still needs native review; particular flags: lamp mechanism 卡/转, 功夫/工夫 register, liǎo in 没完没了, casual travel teasing and the 信 trust sense. No scene claims that emailing constitutes a booking. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
